Name: Rex Deck
Description: Idle isn't always done: Rex Deck turns your Rex sessions into live Stream Deck keys that show which coding agents are blocked, working, still busy with subagents or background tasks, or waiting on a scheduled loop, and adds keys that send commands, text and key presses to them.
Author: Resilient Software

Actions.Name: Rex Session
Actions.Tooltip: Live tile for a Rex session; press to focus it. Green focused, yellow working, red blocked, blue busy in the background, mauve waiting on a timer. Extra sessions page via arrow keys.

Actions.Name: New Rex Session
Actions.Tooltip: Create a new Rex session and focus it. Dims while Rex is offline.

Actions.Name: Agent Summary
Actions.Tooltip: Counts your sessions by state; press to jump to the one that needs you most, blocked first.

Actions.Name: Slash Command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends a slash command such as /review to the focused agent or a pinned session.

Actions.Name: Send Text
Actions.Tooltip: Types a phrase into the focused agent or a pinned session, then presses Enter unless you turn it off.

Actions.Name: Send Keys
Actions.Tooltip: Sends key presses to the focused agent or a pinned session; esc by default, to interrupt.

Actions.Name: Cycle
Actions.Tooltip: Each press sends the next value, such as /model opus, then sonnet, then haiku, to the focused agent or a pinned session.

Actions.Name: New Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a Rex tab in the target pane's folder, or a folder you choose, and focuses it.
